name: v1.106.5
body:
## Verify this release

```bash
cosign verify \
  --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \
  ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.106.5
```

Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images

## What's new in 1.106.5

1 PR. 1 changed. No action needed to upgrade

### Changes

- **Logging and observability:** Changed failure logs for rejected requests to keep only core request fields, `tags` and guardrail details (#48599) <sup>Also in [1.103.10](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.103.10), [1.104.8](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.8), [1.105.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.6)</sup>
- **Logging and observability:** Changed the GCS logger to use the bucket and credentials configured on the proxy (#48599) <sup>Also in [1.103.10](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.103.10), [1.104.8](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.104.8), [1.105.6](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.105.6)</sup>
